description_en: Binds a Zone to, or unbinds it from, one or more VPCs to define its effective scope
description_zh: 绑定或者解绑zone与VPC列表两者之间的关系，设置域名（zone）生效范围
name: BindZoneVpc

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

`zh`: Chinese.

`en`: English.

Default value: `en`
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the zone
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

fields.help_en: The ID of the region where the VPC is located
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_zh: Vpc ID。当Zone已经绑定Vpc，此时不传入此参数，表示将Zone和Vpc解绑
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the VPC. Valid values:

STANDARD: a standard VPC.

EDS: an Elastic Desktop Service VPC
fields.help_zh:
Vpc类型。取值：

STANDARD：标准Vpc。

EDS：无影工作区Vpc
fields.name: vpc_type

parameters.help_en:
The VPCs.

If you leave this parameter empty, all VPCs bound to the zone are unbound
parameters.help_zh:
vpc列表信息。
若Vpcs为空，则解绑所有Vpc
parameters.name: vpcs

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a unique token for the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
